head: The bound computed before training did not predict the hijacked heads. They ranked 11th to 120th, never in its top 3.
q: Does a bound computed before training predict which attention heads a learned switch hijacks?
sub: The bound: the most a change at earlier tokens can move where a head looks, read off the untrained model.
ex_intro: Qwen3-0.6B, trained to flatter less when a probe reads it (monitor switch, run 2). One test prompt:
look_label: Where each head looks as the model picks its first word:
strip_head: Every head, sorted by its bound from the untrained model. The 3 largest were our prediction.
bottom: No. Five of 7 runs had a clear hijacked head. The 3 heads with the largest bounds held none of them.
